notes.title: Homebound - Hotfix 1.0.9.5
notes.content:
Hello!

A hotfix for Homebound was recently uploaded, fixing a problem sometimes causing objects not to be released from the players' hands at certain velocities.

Another update is in the works and it will hopefully be up the coming days!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/497440/

Best regards,
Wiktor Öhman, Lead Developer of Homebound

notes.title: Homebound - Update Recap
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since the release I've been hard at work improving and optimizing Homebound. I thought it could be helpful to gather all the patch notes in one place.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/497440/

Update 1.0.8.5

Increased interactivity in atmosphere re-entry when using Motion Controllers/Oculus Touch
Collision audio for physical actors
Reduced speed of ascend/descend
Made strafing, ascending and descending less sensitive
Strafing should now always be relative to player camera rotation and not character rotation
Reduced turn rate
Several meshes clipping in space station fixed
Increased visual fidelity in escape pod
Reduced fine bloom flicker in first room
Adjusted material reflectance of gloves
Adjusted material reflectance of bags and padding
Several Force Feedback triggers added
Items should no longer be able to be thrown out the cupola window
Reflectance values on set pieces in space station adjusted
Voiceover comments relative to items held should now properly play also when using the left hand
Station disaster will no longer trigger twice in certain scenarios


Update 1.0.8.0

Huge Performance optimization
Improved tracking both for camera and hands
Reduced texture memory usage
Reduced GPU overhead
Optimized shaders
Clearer and sharper visuals
Texture optimization
Space exterior visuals improved
New Voiceover added
Hands visibility bug fixed should now be fixed
Bug causing players not being able to repair the scanner fixed
Updated visuals for scanner objective
Additional interactive objects added
Players should now be able to pull lever with left hand
Blended gripping animation added
Hands' positions adjusted - matches real-world position better
MEL's scanner beam should intersect less with geometry and players
MEL now tracks players when in proximity
Adjusted escape pod trajectory
Improved visuals of directional assistance particles
Lowered camera rotation rate
Bug causing gamepad controls of navigation sequence not to update properly now fixed
Reduced camera shake during disaster sequence
Particle effects optimized
Overall audio levels lowered
Glass reflection over the red button should now render correctly
Overlapping VO during expulsion sequence should now be fixed
Door to The Crib is now opened automatically
Audio feedback when dying of asphyxiation added
Another way of triggering the disaster sequence added
Helmet HUD should no longer clip with other items
Replaced menu cursor - should now be easier to see


Update 1.0.6.0

Player should no longer be able to collide with held objects
Objects should much less frequently shoot off in high speed when flying into them
Bug causing player to drop item in one hand when releasing item held in another fixed
Added two more floppy disks, which should make finding 6 easier
Bug causing held items to stop simulating physics should now be fixed
More batteries for radio added
Batteries should no longer collide with player body, making grabbing easier
Collision model for floppy disks is now larger, making both grabbing and inserting into drive easier
Chips can no longer be triggered an unlimited amount of times
Interactable objects are now outlined/highlighted when in proximity
Fullscreen effect indicating oxygen depletion added
MEL's scanning cone should intersect with player and geometry much less noticably
Helmet HUD moved up slightly, improving readability
Escape pod no longer gets an objective marker - improving readability
Additional voiceover added
Added a little surprise at the end <3


Update 1.0.5.0

Disaster sequence cannot be triggered more than once anymore
Introduction to Free-Roam Mode added
Camera shake during atmosphere level is lowered which should reduce motion sickness
Floppy collection mission completely revamped - is now much more logical and interactive
Force Feedback will no longer be active during loading
New heartbeat force feedback added to crash sequence
Inactive chips bags will no longer play VO
Escape Pod objective should no longer be visible during launch sequence
Escape Pod objective should no longer activate prematurely
Post-process will no longer change when moving to the top-most airlocks
Floppy collection instruction added
Sound should now play correctly when modular wall unfolds
Increased visibility when repairing sensor
Interactable physics assets added
Radio stuck in sleeping compartment fixed
Hands visibility should now be more reliable
Physics object getting stuck should now be much less occuring
Grabbing physics assets with both hands should now work as intended
Player should no longer be able to bump into floppy disks, making them shoot off
Force feedback reduced in atmosphere level
Bug causing black screen to hang before atmosphere should be fixed now


Update 1.0.4.0

Fixed pause bug, sometimes freezing the game
Removed bug allowing players access to escape pod prior to intended story moment
Fixed bug sometimes not making chips bag open when grabbing using gamepad
Made expulsion scene ease-in and ease-out, which should help against motion sickness
Players will always end up in the same location in space after the navigation section
Fixed issue causing animation of wall in 'The Crib' to animate prematurely
Fixed bug causing certain voiceovers not to play
Lever for opening button compartment should now be easier to open with gamepad
Warning sign asset added
Space station exterior adjusted
Hands should no longer be visible when not using motion controllers
Flashlight should now correctly follow the camera view when using gamepad


Update 1.0.3.0

Audio volume should now be more comfortable
Audio clipping should be much less frequently occuring
Gamepad turn speed lowered to a more comfortable speed
Mipmapping of 'Escape Pod' label reduced for make it more readable on lower settings
Camera shake after explosion is now less intense, reducing risk of motion sickness
Made physical assets "brake" less, allowing them to fly further
Players should no longer be able to get stuck between 'The Crib's' door and wall when opening it
Grabbing the door handle on 'The Crib's' door should now be much easier
Added instructions on how to open The Crib's door
Made helmet HUD indicators sharper on lower graphics settings
Made credits screen sharper on lower graphics settings
Player hands should no longer turn visible in Atmosphere level
Optimized lighting in space station
Freeroam controls should now be working correctly
Storyline progression revised


Update 1.0.2.0

Disabled Auto Rotation of camera
General performance improvements


http://store.steampowered.com/app/497440/

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26179231/e3e3800e1cdb62da2a1701bbe0c42683e5819320.png

I want to thank all of you for the amazing feedback you've provided since release!

Best regards,
Wiktor Öhman, Lead Developer of Homebound

notes.title: Homebound - Patch 1.0.5.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

These last 24 hours I've been hard at work gathering feedback and suggestions from you all. I've said it before and, trust me, I will say it again. It's extremely appreciated and helpful.

This patch has improvements, changes and optimizations all across the board, so it's hard to give it a summary, but if I had to choose one aspect to highlight it must be the Floppy Collection Quest which has been completely revamped. Mechanics, new graphics, new VO, sound effects - you name it! Other than that there are new assets, things to do and much more!

Hope you like it!

Version 1.0.5.0 Changelist


Disaster sequence cannot be triggered more than once anymore
Introduction to Free-Roam Mode added
Camera shake during atmosphere level is lowered which should reduce motion sickness
Floppy collection mission completely revamped - is now much more logical and interactive
Force Feedback will no longer be active during loading
New heartbeat force feedback added to crash sequence
Inactive chips bags will no longer play VO
Escape Pod objective should no longer be visible during launch sequence
Escape Pod objective should no longer activate prematurely
Post-process will no longer change when moving to the top-most airlocks
Floppy collection instruction added
Sound should now play correctly when modular wall unfolds
Increased visibility when repairing sensor
Interactable physics assets added
Radio stuck in sleeping compartment fixed
Hands visibility should now be more reliable
Physics object getting stuck should now be much less occuring
Grabbing physics assets with both hands should now work as intended
Player should no longer be able to bump into floppy disks, making them shoot off
Force feedback reduced in atmosphere level
Bug causing black screen to hang before atmosphere should be fixed now


Again, thank you all for the incredible feedback and response - it makes working on Homebound a true joy!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26179231/e3e3800e1cdb62da2a1701bbe0c42683e5819320.png

Best regards,
Wiktor Öhman, Lead Developer of Homebound

notes.title: Homebound - Patch 1.0.3.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Again I have to thank you all for your incredible feedback. I cannot begin to thank you for all the kind words, feedback and critique. Already having a community so invested in helping make Homebound the best experience it can be is incredibly humbling and inspiring.

Despite thorough beta testing, both internally and externally, one can never be truly prepared for what happens in the wild. Working from the feedback we've received since release we've uploaded an update which focuses on audio, story progression and general user experience. You can view the full changelist below.


Audio volume should now be more comfortable
Audio clipping should be much less frequently occuring
Gamepad turn speed lowered to a more comfortable speed
Mipmapping of 'Escape Pod' label reduced for make it more readable on lower settings
Camera shake after explosion is now less intense, reducing risk of motion sickness
Made physical assets "brake" less, allowing them to fly further
Players should no longer be able to get stuck between 'The Crib's' door and wall when opening it
Grabbing the door handle on 'The Crib's' door should now be much easier
Added instructions on how to open The Crib's door
Made helmet HUD indicators sharper on lower graphics settings
Made credits screen sharper on lower graphics settings
Player hands should no longer turn visible in Atmosphere level
Optimized lighting in space station
Freeroam controls should now be working correctly
Storyline progression revised


I hope you will enjoy the changes, and once again - thank you!

Kind regards,
Wiktor Öhman, Lead Developer of Homebound

notes.title: Homebound - Patch 1.0.2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of I want to thank you all for the incredible feedback we've received. We truly appreciate it and it helps us further refine the experience.

Based on the feedback we've received so far we have uploaded a patch for Homebound which addresses the most pressing matters, which are motion sickness, camera control and performance. We will continue to develop smaller patches at a quick pace, so stay tuned! Please let us know if you feel any issues persist and we will keep refining.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26179231/3248777109cd67760b9e272a3630464e22061156.jpg

Again thank you,
Wiktor Öhman, Lead Developer of Homebound
